description: 한국도로공사 부산경남권 톨게이트 진출입 일교통량 [roads, bridges and tunnels] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 해당 데이터는 부산·경남 지역 고속도로 톨게이트를 기준으로 차량의 진출입 교통량을 일 단위로 집계한 정보이다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 차량통행량, 교통데이터, 고속도로정보, 이동패턴, 통행량통계. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
